frozen_config.path_redaction_note: Public archive: dataset path and input_path values use data/initial/<name>; the compiler InstalledDir line was removed. manifest_sha256 and original_manifest_sha256 identify the original private-path manifest frozen before measurement. published_manifest_sha256 identifies the separately serialized public manifest in manifests/initial-v1.json. Only paths and this provenance annotation changed; corpus bytes, source digests, measurements, trial order and machine performance context are unchanged.

corpus.timing_scope: single-thread warm-buffer materialization; encode batch then decode batch; per-buffer times divide batch duration by inner_iterations; fixed batching=min(1024,max(1,ceil(8MiB/input_bytes))); allocation, IO and validation excluded; copies and decisions included; validation after each batch
corpus.storage_scope: payload plus 16-byte page table for compressed methods; source, output, unused reserved capacity, scratch, allocator and OS overhead excluded; not measured RSS
corpus.apple_selection: keep compressed only if payload is strictly smaller than original page
corpus.custom_selection: keep custom output including its headers only if smaller than original page
